testsuite.name: real SQL: shared notification slots, concurrent admission, trusted plans and persistent slot identity

testcase.name: free baseline is 5 total registrations across native auto and price, including paused slots
delete and recreate reuse the lowest empty persistent owner slot and cannot steal another owner target
concurrent workers admit exactly 5 combined slots for one free owner
supporter priority and explicit administrator slot override come only from verified user records
paid policy configuration has no invented defaults, cannot be self-granted, and retains additive trusted legacy extras
downgrades retain registrations and identities; extra slots can be viewed/deleted but cannot send or resume
expiration or disabled configured plan falls back to current trusted free/supporter allowance
legacy subscriptions adopt stable slots without deleting overflow or ignoring paused registrations
